title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（石橋孝一研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Ishibashi Koichi)
educationalGoal: In this capstone project, students will conduct research activities related to ICT (Information and Communication Technology) systems based on the knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology that they have learned so far. Through these activities, students acquire the abilities needed for identifying a problem, designing the project, and implementing an ICT system. Additionally, students will acquire generic abilities related to communicating with others, and evaluating results.
advice:
Recently, Sensor network systems (IoT systems) that collect, analyze, and utilize data from sensors installed throughout the region are attracting attention.
In this project, students learn communication network technology and data analysis technology for IoT systems, which connect enormous IoT devices ubiquitous in society.

Specific research areas focused in this project are as follows:

1. Routing protocol for wireless multihop networks, such as wireless sensor networks.
2. IoT edge computing technology.
3. Communication network by infomation-centric networking such as MQTT.
4. Data analysis technology by AI.
requiredKnowledge: Major achievements are the results of small and daily achievements. Students are recommended to conduct self-checking every quarter.

              In this capstone project, students will conduct research activities related to ICT (Information and Communication Technology) systems based on the knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology that they have learned so far. Through these activities, students acquire the abilities needed for identifying a problem, designing the project, and implementing an ICT system. Additionally, students will acquire generic abilities related to communicating with others, and evaluating results.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Recently, Sensor network systems (IoT systems) that collect, analyze, and utilize data from sensors installed throughout the region are attracting attention.
In this project, students learn communication network technology and data analysis technology for IoT systems, which connect enormous IoT devices ubiquitous in society.

Specific research areas focused in this project are as follows:

1. Routing protocol for wireless multihop networks, such as wireless sensor networks.
2. IoT edge computing technology.
3. Communication network by infomation-centric networking such as MQTT.
4. Data analysis technology by AI.
